The '''Navigation institute''' was located on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. While on their way to the planet [[Ryloth]] aboard the [[cruiser]] [[Obedience|''Defiance'']], [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] informed [[Commandant]] [[Pell Baylo]] that he would be taking a chair at the Navigation institute, while his [[Defiance Flight Training Institute|School]] would be folded under the existing [[Imperial training center|training center]] on Corellia.<ref name="Orientation" />
